{{Quote|That's the highest civilian award the Republic issues. You have changed the tide of this war.|[[Sumalee]]|<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''Senatorial Medal of Service''' was the highest award of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] available to its non-military personnel. [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Leontyne Saresh]] awarded the medal to the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Voidhound]] for defeating Imperial [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Harridax Kirill]] over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] in [[3640 BBY]].<ref name="TOR" />
